test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete 25% of a task in 10 days. B can complete 40% of the task in 40 days and C can complete (1)/(3) of the task in 13 days. Who among them has the fastest speed to complete the same task?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate total days for 100% work for each person.

A → 10 × 4 = 40 days.

B → 40 ÷ 0.4 = 100 days.

C → 13 × 3 = 39 days.

Least days = **Fastest speed**.

**∴ The correct answer is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 A 40 1560 39 
 B 100 15.6 
 C 39 40 

**Given:**

⇒ A: 25% (1/4) work in 10 days → Total time = 10 × 4 = **40 days**.

⇒ B: 40% (2/5) work in 40 days → Total time = 40 × (5/2) = **100 days**.

⇒ C: 1/3 work in 13 days → Total time = 13 × 3 = **39 days**.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed is inversely proportional to time taken.

⇒ Time taken: B (100 days) > A (40 days) > C (39 days).

⇒ Since **C** takes the minimum time, **C** has the **fastest speed**.

**∴ The correct answer is C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to time and work, where filling a tank is positive work and emptying it is negative work.

Man-Days Formula

M₁D₁H₁/W₁ = M₂D₂H₂/W₂, used for comparing work done by different groups.</p
